Kaylee, you did it! You won the Canada Champion trophy!
Kaylee, Canada Champion! From Canada.
This is Canada! It goes all the way from one ocean to the other.
Canada's flag is red and white, with a red maple leaf in the middle.
People in Canada speak English and French. In Quebec, hello is Bonjour!
Canada is the second biggest country in the world.
Canada has long, snowy winters, and red and orange leaves in the fall.
The beaver is Canada's animal. Its teeth are orange and never stop growing.
Most of the world's maple syrup comes from Quebec.
In Quebec City there's a hotel that looks like a castle.
Hockey is Canada's favorite winter sport.
In Banff, animals cross the highway on their own bridges.
Squirrels lick maple sap from the trees too!
The snowy owl is Quebec's bird.
Moose are the biggest deer in the world.
Raccoons wash their food with their little hands.
The loon's call sounds like laughing.
Grizzly bears sleep all winter in a den.
Sea otters hold hands so they don't float away.
The spirit bear is a black bear with white fur.
Real maple taffy on real snow!
The real Winter Carnival in Quebec City!
Real bikes on the real mountain!
Animals that can see in the dark!
A real red canoe on Moraine Lake!
Real animals crossing their bridge!
Real sea otters holding hands!
Real spirit bears catching salmon!
Skating on the real frozen canal!
Maple's animal book! Tap an animal to hear about it.
A snowy owl! It's Quebec's bird.
A red squirrel! It loves maple sap.
A chickadee! It sings its own name: chick-a-dee-dee-dee!
Canada geese! They fly in a big V.
A beluga whale! It is white, and it sings.
A red fox! It hops into the snow to catch mice.
A moose! The biggest deer in the world.
A beaver! It builds its house with sticks.
A black bear! It loves berries.
A chipmunk! It stuffs its cheeks with seeds.
A porcupine! It has prickly quills.
A raccoon! It washes its food with its hands.
A deer! It lifts its white tail to say: run!
A barred owl! It hoots: who cooks for you?
A woodpecker! It drums on trees. Tap tap tap!
A bat! It flies at night and eats bugs.
A firefly! Its tail lights up.
A spring peeper! A tiny frog with a big peep.
A snowshoe hare! Its fur turns white in winter.
An elk! Its call sounds like a squeaky whistle.
A grizzly bear! It sleeps all winter.
A bighorn sheep! Its horns curl round and round.
A mountain goat! It climbs the steepest rocks.
A wolf! Wolves live in a family called a pack.
A pika! A tiny rock rabbit that says eep!
A marmot! It whistles from the rocks.
A ground squirrel! It stands up to look around.
A loon! It dives deep, and its call sounds like laughing.
A bald eagle! Its head is white, not bald.
A trout! It lives in cold mountain water.
An orca! Orcas swim together in families.
A humpback whale! It jumps right out of the water.
A grey whale! It swims all the way from Mexico.
A sea otter! Otters hold hands so they don't float away.
A sea lion! It barks, arf arf!
A harbour seal! It naps on the rocks.
A puffin! It has a bright orange beak.
A sea star! It has five arms.
A salmon! It swims up the river to lay its eggs.
A spirit bear! A black bear with white fur.
A banana slug! Slimy, yellow, and slow.
A raven! A very clever bird.
A bison! It rolls in the dust to stay clean.
A Mountie horse! Mounties are Canada's police on horses.
A polar bear! It lives far up north, by the ice.

text: Bonjour! I'm Maple. I want to see all of Canada, ocean to ocean!
And find a hockey team for the big game in Ottawa!

Push the train with your finger!
Tap a bubble to play!
That one is coming soon!

text: Hello, Banff! Look at the mountains!
Our whole team is here! Let's play!
We need our whole team first!
A new friend for our team!
Round and round, inside the mountain!
Oh! A moose on the track!
Oh! A bison on the track!

Tap it, so it can move!
The CN Tower, in Toronto. It is very tall!
Niagara Falls! Look, a rainbow!
Montmorency Falls. Even taller than Niagara Falls!
A ferry. It takes people across the river.

text: Bonjour! My cousins are coming for a treat!

Tip the pot and pour syrup on the snow!
It's set! Roll it up on a stick.
Still hot! Let it set.
Roll up the rest!
The pot is empty! Tap the maple tree.
Sap from the maple tree makes the syrup!
Pour the shape on Maple's card!
Make each friend the size they want!
Who gets this one?

text: The parade needs snowmen. Let's roll some!

Push the snowball! Watch it grow!
Now roll the little ball into the big one!
Roll a snowball into a box!
Tap the drum for the parade, or make more snowmen!
Put your finger on the snowball and push!
Push the little ball into the big one!
Roll a snowball into the hat box!
Roll a snowball into the sash box!
Tap the big drum!
This castle is really a big hotel!
A moose made of ice!

text: Hee hee! That's for a snowman!
Hello! Why is the sky down there?
Kaylee, you made a whole parade!
Bonjour! I want to ride all the way down to the waterfall!

Hold your finger down and steer the bike!
Two trails! Green or blue?
The bridge, or splash through the creek?
Push your finger left or right!

text: Ha ha! I am all leaves!
Thank you, Kaylee! What a ride!
Shh! Something is out there in the dark.

Move your finger to shine the light!
Look for shiny eyes in the dark!
Listen! Who made that sound?
Shine the light where the sound is.
Follow the little paw prints!
Shine the light on the next paw print.

text: Hee hee! Marshmallows for my babies!

Hold the marshmallow near the fire.
Give it to Maple or the raccoons.
It's on fire! Tap it to blow it out!
Now shine the light at the sky!
Shine the light up high!

text: Look! The sky is full of stars!
Who cooks for you? Hoo hoo!
Bonjour! Why is my lake so blue?

Pull the paddle back through the water!
Hold the water where the canoe should go!
Drag your finger back, beside the canoe.
Press the water in front of the canoe.
Paddle to the milky water by the glacier stream!

text: Ooh! What is that milky water?

Follow the sparkles to the milky water.
Rock flour from the glacier makes the lake so blue!
Bubbles! Follow them to find the loon.
Paddle to the bubbles!

text: Look! A baby loon on her back!

A glacier is a river of ice. It moves very slowly.
The loon is on Canada's dollar coin. It's called a loonie!

text: Bonjour! The animals want to cross the big highway.

Lead them over the animal bridge!
Drag mama elk over the bridge.
The sheep love the rocky way!
Lead the grizzlies over the bridge.
Not on the road! Over the bridge.
The fence keeps the animals off the road.
Click! The camera takes a photo of every animal.
Bonk! The rams bump heads.
Oh! A baby stopped to smell a flower.
Go get the little one!
Walk the others over. They carry seeds!

text: Ooh! It looks like the forest!

You helped them all cross, Kaylee!
Hold the water where the boat should go!
Hold and push to steer the boat!
A sleepy otter floated away. Go gently!
A spout! Steer there to find the whale!
The orca family! Go fast and turn!
Shh! Listen to the whales sing.
Steer out past the lighthouse!
Go slowly to the sleepy otter.
Take her back to her friends!
Look for the spout. Steer there!
Go fast and turn. The baby copies you!
Tap the yellow microphone to listen!

text: They hold hands so they don't float away!
It breathes out of its head!
They all jumped together! Merci, Kaylee!
The salmon are swimming home, up the river!
Can you help them jump the falls?

Grab a salmon, and flick it up!
The big falls! Try the rock, or the log.
The bears are fishing! Flick the salmon past them.
Home! Tap each salmon to lay its eggs.
Spring! Tap the eggs.
Bonk! Try a bigger flick.
Rain! It's a rainforest.
This cedar tree is taller than a house!
Fall... winter... and spring!

text: Ooh! A salmon in my lap!
The bears went to eat berries!
Bye, little salmon! Swim to the sea!
Kaylee, you brought the salmon home!
